status.dbDown: Mewvo is online, but its database is not responding, so some things will not save.

chart.label: Enforcement actions per day: {summary}

total.one: {count} action in 7 days (UTC days, /test cases not counted).
total.other: {count} actions in 7 days (UTC days, /test cases not counted).

needs.endConfirm: End the raid lockdown? The verification level goes back to what it was and paused invites and DMs resume.
needs.heldAtDoor: New members are held at the door
needs.failed: Some of this could not be loaded just now. Reload the page in a minute.
needs.empty: Nothing needs you right now. Appeals, tickets and raid alerts show up here.

notSet.modlog: Mewvo couldn't write to the mod log: no mod log channel is set
notSet.alerts: Mewvo couldn't post a staff alert: no alerts or mod log channel is set

postFailed.missing: Mewvo couldn't post to #{channel}: the channel is gone or is not a text channel
postFailed.refused: Mewvo couldn't post to #{channel}: Discord refused the message
postFailed.fixChannel: Pick a channel on the page.
postFailed.fixPerms: Allow these for Mewvo's role in that channel (Edit Channel → Permissions), or pick another channel.
postFailed.fixOther: Try again later, or pick another channel.

start.button: Set up Mewvo step by step
start.after: It goes through the steps below one at a time.
start.progress: {done} of {total} done. Each step takes a minute; the link opens the right page.

handover.empty: A short message for whoever moderates next, like "keep an eye on #general tonight". Everyone on staff sees it here.
handover.label: Note
handover.hint: To remove the note, empty the box and save.

quick.cases: Every warn, mute, kick and ban

setup.fallback: Until you choose one, it uses the mod log.

modLog.label: Mod log channel
modLog.hint: Mewvo writes every warning, mute, kick and ban there, so your staff can look back later.

review.label: Automod review channel
review.hint: When automod removes a message, it posts a short report there so staff can keep or undo it.

alerts.label: Alerts channel
alerts.hint: For urgent warnings, like a raid (many accounts joining at once).

muted.label: Muted role
muted.hint: Mewvo creates it by itself the first time someone is muted. You can also pick your own role.

appeals.label: Appeals category
appeals.hint: When someone asks to have a punishment lifted, Mewvo opens a private channel for it in this category.

ticketCategory.label: Ticket category
ticketCategory.hint: Tickets let members talk to staff privately. Choose the category their channels go in.

ticketStaff.label: Ticket staff role
ticketStaff.hint: The role that can see and answer tickets.

welcome.label: Welcome channel
welcome.hint: Mewvo greets new members in this channel.

verification.label: Verification
verification.hint: New members press a button to show they are a real person before they can chat.

birthdays.label: Birthday channel
birthdays.hint: Mewvo wishes members a happy birthday there.

bannedRole.label: Banned role in the support server
bannedRole.hint: Banned members get this role in your support server, so they can still appeal there.

permissions.label: Mewvo's permissions
permissions.hint: Mewvo needs some permissions to ban, mute, post and log. The list shows what is missing and how to fix it.

logChannel.label: Main log channel
logChannel.hint: Mewvo writes down deleted and edited messages, joins, leaves and role changes there.

modRole.label: Moderator role
modRole.hint: Members with this role can use moderation commands and open this dashboard as moderators. They cannot ban or change settings.

appealPanel.label: Appeal panel posted
appealPanel.hint: A message with an Appeal button, so punished members can ask staff to lift it. One goes in your server, one in the support server.

perms.title: Mewvo's permissions
perms.intro: What Mewvo's role may do in the whole server, for the features that are on. This only reads them: you change them in Discord. A single channel can still block Mewvo; the channel pickers warn about that.
perms.allOk: Mewvo has every permission it needs.
perms.someMissing: Something is missing ({count}). Until it is fixed, some features do not work.
perms.fix: Needed for: {list}. To fix it: Server Settings → Roles → {role} → turn on {perm}.
perms.roleAboveFix: Mewvo can only give and take roles below its own. In Server Settings → Roles, drag {botRole} above @{role}.
perms.cannotCheck: Mewvo's permissions could not be checked just now. Reload the page in a minute.
